name: Eden
notes: Confirmed against the real repo (git.eden-emu.dev, self-hosted Gitea/Forgejo) - 14 releases found, latest v0.2.1. Each release ships many Linux AppImage variants (gcc-standard, clang-pgo, legacy, rog-ally, steamdeck, aarch64); the pattern here picks the generic amd64 gcc-standard build as a safe default. Edit the pattern in Settings if you want a hardware-specific build instead.
